alerts.description: Non-selective nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory agents (eg, Ibuprofen Oral Capsule 200 MG) may diminish the cardioprotective effect of aspirin. Non-selective nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory agents (eg, Ibuprofen Oral Capsule 200 MG) may enhance the adverse/toxic effect of aspirin. An increased risk of bleeding may be associated with use of this combination. Aspirin may decrease the serum concentration of non-selective nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory agents (eg, Ibuprofen Oral Capsule 200 MG).
Nonselective nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory agents (eg, Ibuprofen Oral Capsule 200 MG) may enhance the anticoagulant effect of vitamin K antagonists (eg, Warfarin Sodium Oral Tablet 5 MG).
Ibuprofen Oral Capsule 200 MG may impair the hypotensive effect of Metoprolol Succinate ER Oral Tablet Extended Release 24 Hour 50 MG.
The use of Ibuprofen Oral Capsule 200 MG may result in an allergic reaction based on a reported history of allergy to ibuprofen.
